svg.title: The CREBAIN drone fixture on the shared-exclusion lattice
svg.desc: Left: the visual and radar bits about the horizontal target form the AND gate, with redundancy 0.085, two unique atoms of 0.131 and synergy 0.216 nats. Right: all 18 net atoms of the visual, radar and acoustic bits about the volumetric target, in thousandths of a nat. The five atoms outside the down-set of the visual-radar pair add up to one quarter of log 2.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: THE DRONE FIXTURE ON THE SHARED-EXCLUSION LATTICE
sum = Hbin(1/4) = I(V, R; TH) = 0.5623 nats
Three sources, target TV: all 18 net atoms (10−3 nats)
Outlined: the atoms the acoustic bit adds; they sum to
I(A; TV | V, R) = ¼ log 2 = 0.1733 nats.
All 18 atoms sum to I(V, R, A; TV) = Hbin(1/8) = 0.3768 nats.
Each is (1/8) log of an exact rational, e.g.
Categorical shared exclusions (Makkeh, Gutknecht and Wibral 2021) on Galadriel's CREBAIN fixture; agrees with the retained pid-core values to all nine printed decimals.
